steps: New-script UI selects shared state, previews v4 and displays the key in the static graph; cancelling leaves all author files unchanged.

Re-edit changes v2 payload comparison to v4 shared state; key changes revoke review. Three languages at 390px preserve key focus and exact source. Apply changes only the draft, ordinary Save changes exactly one TXT, and reopening preserves the declaration.

GUI planning, generation and actual Godot execution read true from combat.enabled while event payload is false. The controller enters idle then attack, yields four executed commands and an attack terminal sample through existing protocol 9; the run preserves all saved author bytes.

dialogs.message: 丢弃本次脚本创建设置？编辑器内容不会改变。

limitations: Actual Chrome HTTP editor and Godot headless execution in a disposable author workspace. No installed Tauri, Android, Bevy or native visual rendering claim.

A fixture prepares scenes, clips, publisher and an existing v2 TXT. UI previews creation, reviews v4, saves one ordinary TXT, reopens it and plans/builds/runs the frozen project. Initial OC creation and binding are fixture setup.
The graph is a static projection of the current valid form. It does not prove runtime state, reachability or execution.
